subject: Exclusive Summer Sale Starts Now!
body: Dear valued customer, We are excited to announce our Exclusive Summer Sale that starts today! Enjoy up to 50% off on selected items including summer apparel, footwear, and accessories. Don't miss out on this limited-time opportunity to refresh your wardrobe at unbeatable prices. Visit our store or shop online to take advantage of these amazing deals. Hurry, the sale ends next week! Happy shopping!
